task: Flagship 6 (shift-roster-builder): the knapsack row (open hours at least the lifted floor) in bnp.mjs's master LP, then re-measure the benches
errors: First version started the open-hours row with an artificial in the basis; the start was infeasible (1 - total/F < 0) and solveLP stopped at once with a bound of 0. Fixed by starting the surplus column basic.

First wiring compared the floor against max(cg.floor, exact search root bound), which already exceeded 100,000 x floor, so the row never ran; compared against the column generation's own floor instead.
Post front matter: description 178 chars and seo_title 73 chars failed check_post_frontmatter.py in venture-preflight; shortened.
integrity_issues: keep-shifts.test.mjs read b.bound from scoreBoundByColumnGeneration, which returns floor, so its 'bound stays below the brute-force best' assertion never ran (Number.isFinite(undefined) is false). Fixed to read floor; passes.

doc_friction.issue: Says to wait with Monitor for conditions, but a foreground until-loop with sleep inside one Bash call worked fine and is simpler; the 'sleep N; cat' form is blocked by a hook, which cost one call.

deviations.why: The flagship's next: said 'then re-measure the 20-60 person benches'. Those weeks are above 60 copies, where the exact search (the source of the proven floor) is skipped, so the row cannot fire there by construction.
deviations.did: Re-measured the 6-15 person benches and templates (where the row could fire) instead, and recorded the 20-60 item as the next step (a coverage-only floor for big weeks).
deviations.result: Same rosters and scores on all 19 weeks; the row never ran there because the first pass already proves them. Stated in the README.

writeups: ventures/shift-roster-builder/README.md (The open-hours row in the score LP)
notes: solveLP generalised to weighted columns (vals); columnGenerationOpen takes openFloor and adds the scaled knapsack row with a surplus column; exactSearch calls back with its final open-hours floor before its score tree and buildRoster reruns score CG with the row. Full venture suite: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py shift-roster-builder -> ok (215.1 s). open-row.test.mjs: 399 brute-force weeks, bound never above best. venture-preflight: clean (after the post front-matter fix).
